verdict.rationale: Granola automatically generates AI-enhanced notes as soon as a call ends or is stopped. Default summarisation adapts to the meeting format, and templates can be chosen or built per call type. Each note line links back to its source in the transcript, and notes can be shared via a copy-link URL; one community user calls it highly capable at summarisation. Missing for 10: no documentation that summaries explicitly break out key points, decisions and next steps; no hands-on evidence the output is good enough to share without editing; one PM reports action items tending to slip through and built a separate tracker.
